english:
And with all adornments going in procession,
sing the Hymn of the Cross in the tone [Gk. / Third Plagal]: "O Four-winged" (Ov k’arat’ev).
Psalm 4: "There was signed..." [4:6] Psalm-response (P'okh): "When I called" [4:1].
Gospel: Luke 23:32. "And they brought..." to verse 46: "...my spirit."
And they shall sign the four corners of the world with the Cross (Andastan).
Litany: "By this Holy Cross."
Prayer: "Keep us" (Pahpanya) [and] Our Father.
And then: "Incline [your ear]" (Khonarhets’o) and "Live" (Aprets’o).
Messedi: "Our God in heaven..." (Astvats mer yerkins). "In the going out of Israel" (Yelaneln Israyeli).
Hambartsi [Hymn at the Evening / Tone Gk. / Third Plagal]: "The Divine..." (Zastvatsayin zleren).
Dismissal Gospel: Mark 4:26. "And he said: So is..." to verse 34: "...he explained everything."

Monday
Morning Hymn [Ah. / Tone Gdz. / Third Mode]: "Let us bless the Lord" (Orhnests’uk’ zk-Ter).
Patristic / Canticle Response (Harts) [Tone Bk. / Second Plagal]: "Who [took the form] of a servant" (Vor ztsarayi).
Morning Gospel: Luke 9:37. "And it came to pass on the next day..." to verse 50: "...is on your side."
Midday Liturgy
Psalm 67 [68]: "Let God arise..." [67:1], "Save me, [O God]" [68:1] [69:1], "O God, to help [me]" [69:1] [70:1].
Acts 13:41. "And when they went out..." to chapter 14:6: "...and there they preached the gospel."
Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to you..." [64:1].
Catholic Epistle: 2 Peter 1:1. "Simon Peter..." to verse 11: "...of the Savior Christ."
Alleluia Psalm 147: "Praise [the Lord], O Jerusalem."
Gospel: John 5:31. "If I bear witness..." to verse 47: "...how will you believe?"

In the Evening
First Gospel: Matthew 12:1. "At that time, [Jesus] went..." to verse 21: "...shall trust."
Messedi: "Let your hand be..." (Yeghits’i dzer’n k’o). "You who shepherd..." (Vor hovuest).
Hambartsi [Tone Gz. / Third Mode]: "You who are above..." (Vor i verd es).
Dismissal Gospel: Mark 4:35. "And he said to them..." to chapter 5:20: "...were amazed."

Tuesday
Morning Hymn [Ah. / Tone Gk. / Third Plagal]: "Victorious" (Yaght’akan).
Patristic / Canticle Response (Harts) [Tone Bk. / Second Plagal]: "Who you were before" (Vor eir yar’aj).
Morning Gospel: Luke 9:51. "And it came to pass, when the days were completed..." to verse 62: "...the kingdom of God."
Midday Liturgy
Psalm 70 [71]: "In you, O Lord..." [70:1], "Give the king your justice, [O God]" [71:1] [72:1], "Truly [God is good]" [72:1] [73:1].
Acts 14:7 [14:8]. "And there was a certain man at Lystra..." to verse 18: "...to his own place."
Catholic Epistle: 2 Peter 1:12. "Therefore I intend..." to verse 19: "...in your hearts."
Alleluia Psalm 20 [21]: "The king shall joy in your strength, O Lord."
Gospel: John 6:1. "After these things..." to verse 14: "...into the world."

In the Evening
First Gospel: Matthew 12:22. "Then was brought..." to verse 37: "...you shall be condemned."
Messedi: "God of gods..." (Astvats astvatsots’). "From the rising of the sun..." (Yelits’n arevu).
Hambartsi [Tone Gk. / Third Plagal]: "Of the angels..." (Hreshtakats’n), and "Your angel" (Hreshtak k’o).
Dismissal Gospel: Mark 5:21. "And when [Jesus] had crossed..." to verse 34: "...from your affliction."

Wednesday
Morning Hymn [Ah. / Tone Dz. / Fourth Mode]: "Let us sing" (Yergests’uk’).
Patristic / Canticle Response (Harts) [Tone Gk. / Third Plagal]: "With voluntary..." (Kamavorut’yamb).
Morning Gospel: Luke 10:1. "After these things..." to verse 24: "...and did not hear."
Midday Liturgy
Psalm 73 [74]: "O God, why..." [73:1], "We give thanks..." [74:1] [75:1], "In Judah God is known..." [75:1] [76:1].
Acts 14:18. "And in their going about..." to verse 27: "...with the disciples."
Psalm 147: "Praise [the Lord], O Jerusalem."
Catholic Epistle: 2 Peter 1:20. "But first this..." to chapter 2:8: "...tormented."
Alleluia Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to you."
Gospel: John 6:15. "Jesus, when [he perceived]..." to verse 21: "...where they were going."

In the Evening
First Gospel: Matthew 12:38. "Then some answered..." to verse 50: "...sister and mother."
Messedi: "The Lord is powerful..." (Ter karogh). "The earth is the Lord's..." (Tyarn e yerkir).
Hambartsi [Tone Adz. / First Mode]: "Who by ineffable essence..." (Vor anch’ar’ eut’yamb).
Dismissal Gospel: Mark 5:35. "While he was speaking..." to verse 43: "...something to eat."

Thursday
Morning Hymn [Ah. / Tone Ak. / First Plagal]: "Sing to the Lord" (Yergetsek’ tyarn).
Patristic / Canticle Response (Harts) [Tone Dz. / Fourth Mode]: "We glorify..." (P’aravorurk’).
Morning Gospel: Luke 10:25. "And behold, there stood up..." to verse 42: "...shall be taken away from her."
Midday Liturgy
Psalm 76 [77]: "With my voice..." [76:1] [77:1], "Give ear, [O my people]" [77:1] [78:1], "O God, the heathen are come..." [78:1] [79:1].
Acts 15:1. "And certain men came down..." to verse 20: "...farewell."
Psalm 98 [99]: "Extol the Lord..." [98:5].
Catholic Epistle: 2 Peter 2:9. "The Lord knows..." to verse 22: "...wallowing."
Alleluia Psalm 14 [15]: "Lord, who shall dwell...?"
Gospel: John 6:22. "The next day..." to verse 38: "...who sent me."

In the Evening
First Gospel: Matthew 14:1. "At that time..." to verse 23 [13:23]: "...some thirtyfold."
Messedi: "Your throne, O God..." (At’or’ k’o Astvats). "My heart overflowed..." (Bghkheat’s).
Hambartsi [Tone Ak. / First Plagal]: "Wonderful Resurrection" (Hrashali haryut’yun).
Dismissal Gospel: Mark 6:1. "And he went out from thence..." to verse 6: "...their unbelief."

Friday
Morning Hymn [Ah. / Tone Bdz. / Second Mode]: "Let us bless" (Orhnests’uk’).
Patristic / Canticle Response (Harts) [Tone Gz. / Third Mode]: "Glorified Son" (P’aravoryal Vordi).
Morning Gospel: Luke 11:1. "And it came to pass in a certain place..." to verse 13: "...that ask him."
Midday Liturgy
Psalm 79 [80]: "Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel..." [79:1] [80:1], "Sing aloud unto God..." [80:1] [81:1], "God stands [in the congregation]..." [81:1] [82:1].
Acts 15:30. "So when they were dismissed..." to chapter 16:5: "...daily."
